candidates.instruction: In `axil_wr_if`, keep synchronous reset on `aw_full`, `w_full`, `b_valid`, and `b_resp`, but move `aw_addr`, `w_data`, and `w_strb` capture into separate enabled sequential logic without reset; capture on the corresponding valid/ready handshake, including during reset. Preserve the existing handshake, response, and write conditions. The integration testbench must confirm reset behavior, independent AW/W capture, held requests, and all top-level outputs remain cycle-identical.
